changelog:
Initial release of "identify-rd-directions-rd": Convert concrete project requirements into evidence-backed R&D direction reports.

- Transforms technical, engineering, or scientific requirements into structured R&D directions with traceable analysis.
- Produces canonical JSON, synchronized Markdown, and HTML reports from validated payloads.
- Integrates requirement analysis, technical issue decomposition, evidence retrieval, and deliverable creation.
- Emphasizes explicit input and scope boundaries, artifact validation, and robust completion gating.
- Designed for evidence-backed decomposition of R&D problems, not for legal, patentability, or safety assessments.
summary: Convert a concrete engineering, scientific, manufacturing, or technical project requirement into evidence-backed R&D directions, including requirement analysis, bounded technical issues, research questions, tasks, targets, deliverables, patent and literature evidence, standards and engineering cases, relevant organizations, search logs, and synchronized Markdown and HTML reports. Use when a user asks what R&D directions to pursue, how to decompose a project into research routes, or needs an evidence-led R&D direction report.
